outline|3 days from pune to goa. i use a.title: 3-Day Pune to Goa Trip: Beaches & Food, Step-Free Focus
outline|3 days from pune to goa. i use a.summary: This trip is designed for a traveler using a wheelchair, focusing on step-free routes, accessible hotels, and well-known beaches and restaurants in Goa. All places were chosen because they are likely to suit your needs, but accessibility details must be checked before booking.

traveler.notes: Budget is about 30,000 rupees. Prioritize comfort, rest, and easy transfers. Always confirm accessibility with each venue before travel.

days.title: Travel from Pune to Goa & Settle In

items.name: Flight: Pune to Goa (Dabolim Airport)
items.note: Direct flight is the fastest and likely most comfortable. Request wheelchair assistance with the airline in advance.

items.name: Taxi to Hotel
items.note: Pre-book a taxi and request a vehicle with space for a wheelchair.

items.name: Check-in: Novotel Goa Resort & Spa
items.note: Rest and settle in. Request an accessible room with roll-in shower if available.

items.name: Dinner at Fisherman’s Wharf
items.note: Popular Goan restaurant. Call ahead to check for step-free entry and accessible restrooms.

items.name: Visit: Miramar Beach
items.note: Known for its flat promenade and easy access. Bring a beach wheelchair if possible.

items.name: Lunch at Ritz Classic
items.note: Famous for Goan seafood. Confirm step-free access before visiting.

items.name: Rest at Hotel or Poolside
items.note: Enjoy hotel amenities and take a break. Ask staff for assistance if needed.

items.name: Visit: Baga Beach Promenade
items.note: Explore the promenade area, which is likely to have step-free paths. Avoid sandy areas if mobility is limited.

items.name: Lunch at Britto’s
items.note: Beachfront restaurant with a lively atmosphere. Call ahead to ask about ramps and accessible restrooms.

items.name: Taxi to Goa International Airport
items.note: Book a taxi with space for your wheelchair. Allow extra time for airport procedures.

items.name: Flight: Goa to Pune
items.note: Request wheelchair assistance for boarding and arrival.

tips: Contact all hotels and restaurants in advance to confirm step-free access, ramps, lifts, and accessible restrooms.
Request wheelchair assistance at airports and with airlines when booking your flight.
Pre-book taxis and specify your mobility needs for easier transfers.
Bring any personal mobility aids you may need, such as a portable ramp or beach wheelchair.
Plan for plenty of rest breaks and avoid crowded or uneven areas.

access.summary: Baga Beach has some accessibility features such as ramps and accessible restrooms, but step-free access is limited due to soft sand. Accessible parking is available, but the environment may still be challenging for wheelchair users.
